title: Slot Rack Container Reskin to Roster Materic Style
description: Apply the Roster Materic/Wanderlust container styling (bronze/gold border, dark gradient inner color, and subtle grain texture from /assets/ui/bg.png) to the ResidentSlotRack container on /minimal-slotRack. The slot internals and the page shell must remain unchanged.
objectives: Create a new `slot_rack_materic` skin preset in `slotRackSkinConfig.ts` that reproduces the roster container border, inner gradient, and grain overlay
Update `ResidentSlotRack.tsx` `rackShellStyle` to support multi-layer backgrounds and blend modes via CSS custom properties (additive, backward compatible)
Apply the new preset to `ResidentSlotRackSkin` on `/minimal-slotRack` via the `skinPresetId` prop without changing the page layout, header, or background
Leave slot appearance (Slot, SlottedMedal, labels, drop states) unchanged
success_criteria: `/minimal-slotRack` container has rounded corners, dark roster gradient, gold/bronze shadow outline, and visible `bg.png` grain overlay matching `/minimal-roster`
No hardcoded colors/borders in component code; all visual tokens live in `slotRackSkinConfig.ts`
Existing slot rack tests still pass
`npm run lint --`, `npm run build:check`, and `npm run kanban:lint` pass for the touched scope

invariants: Config-first: all border, background, shadow, and grain values come from `slotRackSkinConfig.ts`
Skin system: no new standalone `.css` files; use CSS custom properties and existing skin registry
Component reuse: check `src/ui/idleVillage/skins/primitives/` and `src/ui/wanderlust-surface/` before creating a new wrapper; prefer CSS-variable-driven shell
i18n: no new user-facing strings; if labels are added, route them through `react-i18next` `idleVillage` namespace
State management: this is a visual reskin only; no state changes or persistence
trusted_frozen_components: `slotRackKit` is frozen (COMPONENT_MASTER_INDEX). Changes inside `ResidentSlotRack`/`ResidentSlotRackSkin` source must preserve the kit contract and pass kit tests.
forbidden_actions: Do not change the page header, page background, or page layout in `minimal-slotRack.tsx`
Do not alter slot inner styling (Slot, medal, labels, drop-state colors)
Do not use `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` or synchronous persistence

files_to_create: No new files are strictly required; the new preset lives in `slotRackSkinConfig.ts`
files_to_modify: `src/ui/idleVillage/skins/slotRackSkinConfig.ts` — add `SLOT_RACK_MATERIC_CONFIG`, register it, and map preset ids

`src/ui/idleVillage/components/ResidentSlotRack.tsx` — extend `rackShellStyle` to read `--slot-rack-bg-blend`, `--slot-rack-bg-size`, `--slot-rack-bg-repeat`, `--slot-rack-bg-position` via `var(...)` with safe defaults
component_reuse_requirements: Verify that no existing `InsetPanel`, `WanderlustSurface`, or `Skin*` primitive already provides a rounded bronze/dark container with grain before adding a new wrapper
If `rackShellStyle` CSS variables are sufficient, do not introduce a new component

unit_tests: Add/update `ResidentSlotRack.skin.integration.test.tsx` to assert `--slot-rack-bg` contains the roster gradient and grain URL when `slot_rack_materic` is active
Run existing `ResidentSlotRack.unit.test.tsx` and `ResidentSlotRack.medal.test.tsx` to ensure no regression
visual_verification: Load `/minimal-slotRack` and confirm the rack container has the same rounded dark shell and grain as `/minimal-roster`
Confirm slots still render with their existing skin (no gold overlay on slots)

documentation_updates: Update `src/docs/docs/minimal_slice/03_slotRack.md` to mention the `slot_rack_materic` skin preset
Add JSDoc to any new helper or mapping function in `slotRackSkinConfig.ts`

notes.roster_reference_values: The roster container under `DragTestContainer` `useWanderlustSkin` uses `rounded-[20px]`, `bg-[linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,2,2,0.95)_0%,rgba(6,4,3,0.98)_100%)]`, and `shadow-[inset_0_1px_0_rgba(216,177,62,0.08),0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.6),0_0_0_1px_rgba(216,177,62,0.05)]`.
notes.grain_reference: `MATERIC_SKIN_CONFIG.grain` uses `/assets/ui/bg.png` with opacity `0.1` and `mixBlendMode` `normal`. Implement the grain as a blended layer over the container gradient (e.g. `background: url('/assets/ui/bg.png'), linear-gradient(...)` with `backgroundBlendMode: soft-light, normal`).
notes.css_vars_approach: `ResidentSlotRack` `rackShellStyle` already reads `--slot-rack-bg`, `--slot-rack-border`, `--slot-rack-border-radius`, `--slot-rack-padding`, and `--slot-rack-shadow`. Add `--slot-rack-bg-blend`, `--slot-rack-bg-size`, `--slot-rack-bg-repeat`, and `--slot-rack-bg-position` as optional vars with safe defaults. Then populate them in the new preset.
notes.preset_mapping: Add `slot_rack_materic` to `SLOT_RACK_SKIN_REGISTRY`, `getSlotRackSkinForPreset` (handle `materic` and `slot_rack_materic`), and `SLOT_RACK_PRESET_OVERRIDES` if a short alias is desired.
notes.page_change_note: The only `minimal-slotRack.tsx` change is adding `skinPresetId="slot_rack_materic"` to the existing `ResidentSlotRackSkin`. Do not change the header, page background, or surrounding layout.
notes.skills: Before editing, invoke `agent-execution-mandate` and `idle-village-task` skills, then follow their safeguard and reporting instructions.
